name: Angel Lips
source:
Two high school girls lead a normal school life at the same class. But after an accident their contrasting everyday life breaks apart in a stream of lust. One more experienced, one more naive, but in the sunset city their purity is lost forever.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]

Original novel: 堕天使少女 (Datenshi Shoujo) by 花園 乱 (Hanazono Ran)
translation:
两个女高中生在同一个班级过着正常的学校生活。但一场事故后，他们截然不同的日常生活在欲望的洪流中崩溃了。一个多了经验，一个多了天真，但在夕阳之城，他们的纯洁永远消失了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]

原著小说：花园乱 (Hanazono Ran) 的《堕天使少女》
